consequence.statement: Cilium keeps running, but the metric formerly exposed as doublewrite_identity_crd_total_count is now exposed as doublewrite_crd_identities, so anything still querying the old metric name will no longer receive data for it.
consequence.remediation: Update any dashboards, alerts or recording rules that query doublewrite_identity_crd_total_count to use doublewrite_crd_identities.

assertion.statement: The Cilium metric `doublewrite_identity_crd_total_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_crd_identities` in 1.17.0.
